gaps.step: managed_fleet is a subset of register_records
gaps.what: 1 managed point(s) are not in the register export: 742896839

the register-chain note on this page says the fleet is the successfully rehabilitated points plus a handful never rehabilitated. The works form supports 686 successful, which leaves 46 managed non-Marolinta points with no successful first-rehabilitation record - far more than the note allows for.

calendar_evidenced_2026.decided: The gardien calendar is the official record of days operational.
calendar_evidenced_2026.name: 2026 calendar-evidenced points
calendar_evidenced_2026.rule: Carbon-fleet points with a readable gardien calendar sheet dated 2026, the year read off the sheet itself. This is what the days-operational evidence rests on.

carbon_fleet.decided: Marolinta is Deichmann-funded and enters no carbon figure, so it cannot be in a carbon denominator.
carbon_fleet.name: Carbon fleet
reads: as managed_fleet, less the Marolinta site
carbon_fleet.rule: The managed fleet less Marolinta. This is the denominator under every carbon figure on the page.

down_now.decided: Status is the last thing anyone recorded about a pump.
down_now.name: Points down now
down_now.rule: Managed points whose most recent record - call, maintenance visit or repair - says the pump is not working.

first_rehabilitated.decided: A first rehabilitation is what puts a point into the programme. The record is the evidence it happened.
first_rehabilitated.name: First-rehabilitated points
reads: Clean Water || Première réhabilitation / Entretien préventif / Réparation après panne
first_rehabilitated.rule: Water points with a first-rehabilitation record on the works form, whatever the outcome. One point can carry more than one such record; the point is counted once.

managed_fleet.decided: Adriaan Mol, COO SaniTap - the standing reconciliation recorded in data/register_corrections.json
managed_fleet.name: Managed fleet
reads: the register, reconciled against the works and call forms by the weekly build
managed_fleet.rule: The water points MadAvance actively maintains today - the fleet this report is about. Every one has a maintenance history: it is visited, repaired and called about. This is the population behind “water points in scope”.

marolinta.decided: Marolinta is funded separately and is not in the VPA.
marolinta.name: Marolinta
reads: Clean Water || Suivi avancement nouveau forage et réhabilitation
the Marolinta deployment of that form
marolinta.rule: The Marolinta boreholes. Deichmann-funded, and outside the carbon programme entirely - they enter no carbon figure.

register_records.decided: The group is the boundary of what MadAvance holds. Not a decision so much as a fact about the account.
register_records.name: Register records
register_records.rule: Every water-point record in the MadAvance group in mWater. This is everything MadAvance holds, most of which we do not maintain: surveys, points handed on, rope pumps, abandoned points.

rehabilitated_successfully.decided: A rehabilitation that did not succeed does not put a point into the maintained fleet.
rehabilitated_successfully.name: Successfully rehabilitated points
reads: question "Vérifier : La réparation ou la maintenance a réussi ?" = Oui
rehabilitated_successfully.rule: Of the first-rehabilitated points, those whose record answers Yes to “Verify: did the repair or maintenance succeed?”. A point with any successful first-rehabilitation record counts as successful.
